summary: Yueda Digital Holding filed a 6-K to provide notice and proxy for an extraordinary general meeting on June 12/13, 2026 to consider a share capital reduction and reorganization under Cayman Islands law. The proposal reduces par value of issued Class A and B ordinary shares from US$4.00 to US$0.0001 by cancelling US$3.9999 paid-up capital per share, creating a distributable reserve. Authorized but unissued shares are subdivided 1-for-40,000, then a cancellation reduces authorized share capital to US$1,000 split into 9,000,000 Class A and 1,000,000 Class B shares at US$0.0001 par. No price, premium, advisor, or stake is stated. This is a capital structure simplification/recapitalization, not an acquisition or special situation event. Watch shareholder approval and Cayman legal compliance; no arbitrage angle.
